title: Announcing the next generation of Lucidchart
summary: Learn more about the redesigned Lucidchart editor, which reframes Lucid’s powerful capabilities into a minimalistic, intuitive environment.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


-


The redesigned Lucidchart editor has been modernized to reframe Lucid’s powerful capabilities into a minimalistic, intuitive environment.


-


Lucid AI and essential tools are now placed front and center in a unified toolbar, reducing context switching and accelerating workflow execution.


-


New, role-based toolkits automatically surface relevant shape sets and features for specific tasks, eliminating manual configuration time.


-


A high-powered search in the left-hand toolbar acts as a single shortcut to immediately locate any tool, shape, or asset that isn’t readily visible on the canvas.


-


Anyone can opt in early via any Lucidchart document before the new interface officially becomes the default for everyone on December 7, 2026.


Since 2010, Lucidchart has pioneered intelligent diagramming, helping over 100 million people visualize complex processes, systems, and ideas. Now, we’re announcing the next generation of Lucidchart: a streamlined, AI-powered user interface designed to maximize speed, focus, and clarity.


Lucidchart’s evolved interface was reimagined for the future of work, offering job-specific toolkits with integrated AI features that help surface the most important tools right when you need them. With simplified access to features, you can eliminate cognitive overload by staying focused on your work, not your workspace.


Keep reading to learn more about what’s changed in the new Lucidchart editor and how it empowers teams to accelerate work by seamlessly connecting tactical workflows to overarching strategy.


See the difference between the old and new Lucidchart editors.


## A high-focus, modern workspace


Mapping out complex architectures or massive business systems can be a heavy lift. To help you save you time and mental energy, we took everything you love about our powerful diagramming engine and refined it into a clean, high-precision interface.


The following updates were designed to enable deep focus on complex problems:


-


**Lucid AI front and center:** Integrates AI seamlessly into your workflows, so you can accomplish work faster


-


**Enhanced, clearer interface style:** Refreshes the environment to feel like a "precision instrument," shifting the perception from a cluttered canvas to a serious execution workspace


-


**Dark mode:** Directly reduces eye strain during long working sessions, allowing you to sustain focus without digital fatigue


With the new Lucidchart editor, you have the option to switch to dark mode.


## Frictionless editing in a familiar environment


Every time you stop to find a menu or drag your cursor across the screen to change formatting, your flow state gets interrupted. These micro-frictions seem small on their own, but when multiplied across an entire team, the loss of time and momentum is exponential. By eliminating these barriers, the Lucidchart editor becomes an extension of thought, letting you build and iterate at the speed of your ideas.


Here are the updates that reduce friction by placing core tools exactly where you need them:


-


**New core toolbar:** Eliminates context-switching by grouping shapes, text, connectors, and other essentials in a single, predictable location instead of separate panels


-


**Robust left panel:** Offers other tools you need outside of your toolbar such as toolkits, integrations, data linking options, templates, and more


-


**Improved shape property editing:** Keeps context relevant by enabling light edits via a floating bar, while housing deep configurations in the right panel


Pin items on either the toolbar, to apply to any Lucid document you're using, or in the left panel, which will stay consistent to anyone accessing that particular document.


Use the custom floating bar to make quick edits as you work.


## Instant discoverability and job relevance


Teams spend a lot of time setting up their documents. This involves navigating menus to find the right features, scrolling through shape libraries, and searching for other assets needed to build diagrams. By instantly providing role-relevant toolkits and a unified search, the new Lucidchart editor reduces the time it takes to go from blank canvas to finished diagram.


Here are the updates that eliminate configuration time, so you can jump in and start creating faster:


-


**New toolkits (starter packs for specific jobs):** Provides the exact shape sets and features you need to get started, whether you’re mapping architecture or creating process documentation


-


**One high-powered search:** Serves as the ultimate shortcut, providing a single, unified search for tools or assets that aren’t immediately visible


Select a toolkit with everything you need for specific jobs.


## What customers are saying about the new experience


Those who participated in early testing have had overwhelmingly positive reactions to the new Lucidchart editor.


Here’s a sampling of what they had to say:


-


“I really like the new design. I feel like I have more space to work.”


-


“It makes it simple, easier, and quicker to use everything.”


-


“I can select whatever I want within the toolkit, and it just pops up there.”


-


“It had everything I needed for quick actions and staying in flow.”


-


"I really liked having that floating bar. I ended up using it quite a bit.”


-


“It felt more organized."


-


"Search was fantastic! Spot on."


-


"Dark mode was definitely advantageous, much easier on the eye.”


-


"I was surprised how quickly I adjusted to it."


-


"It's beautiful. I turned it on and never looked back"


## How to opt in


The new editor will replace the current interface on December 7, 2026. But if you’re ready to try it out now, early access is available to everyone! Simply log in to Lucid or open a Lucidchart document, and when prompted, opt in to start creating and collaborating in your future workspace. If you don't see the prompt or previously closed it, you can still go to the file menu and select **New editor** .


Welcome to the next chapter of visual collaboration!


### Hands-on workshop


Join our upcoming webinar to get hands-on with the new Lucidchart editor—or watch on demand after it airs. Hit the ground running, so you can continue your work in Lucid faster than ever.


[Learn more](https://lucid.co/resources/webinars/experience-the-new-lucidchart-editor-nov-2026)


## About Lucid


Lucid Software is the leader in visual collaboration and work acceleration, helping teams see and build the future by turning ideas into reality. Its products include the Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite (Lucidchart and Lucidspark) and airfocus. The Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite, combined with powerful accelerators for cloud and process transformation, empowers organizations to streamline work, foster alignment, and drive business transformation at scale. airfocus, an AI-powered product management and roadmapping platform, extends these capabilities by helping teams prioritize work, define product strategy, and align execution with business goals. The most used work acceleration platform by the Fortune 500, Lucid's solutions are trusted by more than 100 million users across enterprises worldwide, including Google, GE, and NBC Universal. Lucid partners with leaders such as Google, Atlassian, and Microsoft, and has received numerous awards for its products, growth, and workplace culture.
